name: persian-holidays
title: Persian Holidays
description: Official/religious/cultural Iranian holiday lookup for a date, range, or year, resolving Jalali, Gregorian, and tabular-Hijri entries.

/**
 * Recurring Iranian holidays and observances (month/day, not year-specific).
 *
 * Vendored and trimmed from BaseMax/persian-holidays-api (MIT), see Credits on the docs page.
 * "jalali" and "gregorian" entries are exact. "hijri" (lunar) entries are resolved per-year
 * with a tabular Hijri calendar in persian-holidays.ts and are approximate by nature -- Iran
 * announces religious holidays by moon sighting, so real dates can shift by up to a day.
 */
export interface PersianHolidayEntry {
  calendar: "jalali" | "gregorian" | "hijri"
  /** Whether this is an official day off, as opposed to a commemorative occasion. */
  official: boolean
  title: string
  /** 1-indexed month in its own calendar field above. */
  month: number
  day: number
}
